answer: Trust propagates from anchored identities through bounded-length random walks on the attestation graph, so an endorsement’s influence follows path probability rather than multiplying without limit. A sybil cluster connected to honest nodes only by a sparse cut has low conductance; with a fixed honest seed distribution, the min-cut limits walk flow into the cluster and bounds its aggregate voting weight. Marble, plume, and timber can serve as arbitrary node labels, not sources of trust.
